mentions.name: Routine launcher app
mentions.description: This is an Android launcher app published on Google Play that users install and set as their device's default launcher.
mentions.problem: The builder worries that most people are not comfortable changing their default launcher.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a launcher app - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nurgasemetey.routineapp but can't stop thinking that most of people are not comfortable with changing their default launcher.
